summary: DeFi Development Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a sales agreement with R.F. Lafferty Co. for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $200 million of common stock. No specific price, share count, or premium is stated. The company may sell shares at market prices through the agent under its effective S-3 shelf. Proceeds are for working capital, digital asset acquisition, and strategic initiatives. This is a routine equity distribution facility, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural complexity is noted. Watch for gradual share sales and dilution over time; no risk-arb angle exists.
